subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When a frozen v1 task is read, the system shall translate its explicit rung through a versioned compatibility table or classify an absent rung as `legacy_unassessed` with frontier capability, maximum deliberation, extended context, and an assurance floor that existing risk signals may raise.
rationale: old plans allowed no rung and cannot be rewritten
fit_criterion: rung fixtures translate exactly; absent-rung fixtures receive the conservative profile; source bytes remain unchanged
